Nick Cohen

From Conservapedia
Jump to navigation Jump to search
415073147 62559f65d9.jpg
Nick Cohen is a British, neo-conservative columnist for the Observer and New Statesman, and also often write op-eds for the London Evening Standard and New Humanist.
His newest book What’s Left?: How Liberals Lost Their Way , published in 2007, tells the story of "how the liberal-Left of the 20th century ended up supporting the far Right of the 21st" and asks "why is it that apologies for a militant Islam that stands for everything the liberal-Left is against come from a section of the Left?"

Books

_Cruel Britannia_ (1999)
_Pretty Straight Guys_ (2003)
_[What’s Left?: How Liberals Lost Their Way](http://www.amazon.co.uk/gp/product/product-description/0007229690/)_ (2007)
